run_asr_evaluation: run the ASR evaluation pipeline on a raw manifest using a wav2vec checkpoint and compute error rates
prepare_w2v_data: prepare wav2vec data files by copying the dictionary, writing TSV audio paths, and preprocessing text labels
run_asr_inference: run ASR inference via subprocess using a wav2vec checkpoint with viterbi decoder and CTC criterion
compute_error_rate: compute word or character error rates by comparing hypothesis and reference text files using edit distance
preprocess_text: preprocess text by uppercasing, removing non-alphabetic characters, and joining tokens with spaces
